name: Novel / unexplained outbreaks
summary: No unexplained cluster under international investigation; recent WHO reports cover sporadic known-virus cases
state: WHO reported on 13 Nov two sporadic MERS cases in Qatar with no onward spread (WHO). WHO's 2 Nov report on the first known human Shamonda virus infection, a fatal case in France, found no further human cases and no evidence of human-to-human spread (WHO). Searches to 17 Nov found no unexplained cluster or novel pathogen under international investigation, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: Nothing new to act on. WHO's Disease Outbreak News and UKHSA publish any change in advice; travellers can check NHS fit for travel for destination guidance.
rubric_hit: No unexplained clusters under international investigation = Normal

sources.title: WHO — Shamonda virus in human, France (DON623)

why: The next pandemic will start as an unexplained cluster; early signals matter.
drivers: Surveillance reports, unknown illnesses, new pathogens.
